ic_name: IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol (PTP) Clock Synchronization Engine (PTPv2 / IEEE 802.1AS)
notes: PTP characterization centers on the sync error (1PPS vs reference), offsetFromMaster convergence and servo lock, path-delay accuracy (including asymmetry), the hardware-timestamp resolution at the MAC/PHY plane, Transparent-Clock residence-time correction, BMCA convergence, and holdover. Conformance is established by IEEE 1588 / IEEE 802.1AS test suites.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: 1PPS sync error
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure the disciplined 1-pulse-per-second against a reference (target sub-microsecond, typically tens of ns).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: offsetFromMaster convergence
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the servo drives offsetFromMaster to zero and holds lock.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: meanPathDelay accuracy
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate path-delay measurement under symmetric and asymmetric links.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Hardware-timestamp resolution
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the MAC/PHY timestamp granularity and stability.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Transparent-clock residence time
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify residence-time correction into the correctionField.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: BMCA convergence
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm deterministic Grandmaster election and re-election on master loss.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Holdover stability
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure local-oscillator holdover after the master is removed.
